---
description: Compare a proposed ServiceNow change against current-state evidence and approved reference architecture.
---

Use:
- Context Curator
- Instance Discovery Agent when live configuration is relevant
- Policy & Standards Guardian
- ServiceNow Architect

Return:

1. Requirement
2. Current State
3. Approved / Reference Standard
4. Gap
5. Options
6. Tradeoffs
7. Recommendation
8. Risk tier
9. Evidence
10. Human decisions

Do not call current configuration "best practice" merely because it exists.
